subject: Late report
text: I'm responding to the complaint about yesterday's late report, because I think part of it lands on me as your classmate, not just your project partner. You said the file arrived after the deadline and included the wrong appendix, which totally made your morning rough. I'm sorry for that. The late part happened because I waited on final figures, and the wrong appendix happened because I copied the folder from last week. Neither excuse fixes it. I checked the log, and the corrected file was in the shared drive at 9:04, so if the issue is that the notification failed, we can try naming files with the date and version in a simpler way. I also have a helpful suggestion: let's make a tiny checklist before anyone submits. It would have three lines, deadline, source, appendix label. If we both use it, it should catch the kind of mix-up that happened this time. I'm happy to set one up, or you can send me your notes and I'll merge them tonight. Thanks for saying it plainly, even though it stung. Also, if your client keeps asking for timestamps, I can screenshot the drive activity. That might help you explain the delay without sounding defensive. And if the appendix confusion is the real sore spot, maybe we keep one blank folder named Approved Final. I won't move files from there. Let me know what feels most useful, and I'll do it before tomorrow's check-in.
